Mother, Child Die as House Structure Collapses in Dewas Rain

In Khatamba village, Dewas, a house structure collapsed during heavy rainfall, resulting in the deaths of a mother and her child. The incident also left three other individuals injured. Reports indicate that guests were eating when the cemented gallery fell, transforming a moment of joy into tragedy.
